citation.title: Topological dimensionality reduction-based machine learning for efficient gradient-free 3D topology optimization
citation.authors: Zhaoyou Sun, Yaguang Wang, Pai Liu, Yangjun Luo
citation.venue: Materials & Design 220 (August 2022) 110885 (Crossref). Gold open access: Crossref lists a CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 licence for the version of record
citation.version_coded: none; only the abstract was read (pool record, from OpenAlex)

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no full text). The abstract claims that a material-field series expansion (under 200 design variables) with a sequential DNN surrogate cuts computing time by 1-4 orders of magnitude versus coarse-mesh gradient-free methods, enabling gradient-free 3D TO with thousands of elements.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Not coded (no full text). The abstract states a reduction of 1-4 orders of magnitude (10x to 10,000x) against coarse-mesh-based gradient-free methods; not checked against the article.
claim.alternatives: Not assessed (no full text). The abstract also reports an effective bulk modulus at 98% of the Hashin-Shtrikman bound and a 16.59% lower peak weld stress in a phone-drop case, without naming the comparator.
